description: Browse Alexandria data providers and workflows or read a selected contract. Alexandria covers companies, people, jobs, finance and filings, public records and government spending, real estate, places and restaurants, retail and prices, package registries and developer data, news, research, and more: typed, sourced records through published contracts. Prefer normal firecrawl_search for a data task; it already returns matching providers. Use this tool when the contract you need was not returned in full, to browse a category when search found nothing, or before scraping the same fields from several pages. Discovery is free. Use query for semantic discovery or urls to find providers for a website. With no arguments, browse categories, then providers and tools. Contracts describe the inputs and outputs for execution through firecrawl_scrape. nextTool identifies further discovery or pagination. Discovery does not execute providers. Use firecrawl_search when you also need web results.

capabilities.description: Exact capability IDs. A selected capability expands its complete contract by default.

categories.description: Category IDs returned by an empty call. Lists providers by default.

expand.description: Use ["options", "response"] for inputs and output shape without example payloads; [] keeps results compact. Omit for full contracts on selected capabilities.

groups.description: Optional group IDs for explicit group browsing.

providers.description: Provider IDs returned by category browsing. Lists compact tools by default.

query.description: Semantic lookup of tools for the data you need. Selectors constrain the search.

name: firecrawl_find_tools

outputSchema.description: One page of the Alexandria catalogue: categories, providers, tools, or one contract.

agent_hints.description: Optional response guidance from the Firecrawl API.

data.description: Discovery page in `data.alexandria[0].data`, with `level`, `items`, `total`, and an optional `nextTool`.

delivery.description: `retained` when the full result stayed server-side instead of being inlined.

error.description: Error message or error object when the call did not succeed.

estimatedTokens.description: Estimated token cost of the full result.

feedbackTool.description: Pointer to the feedback tool for reporting how this result served the task.

idleTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a retained workspace stays available while idle.

inlineTokenBudget.description: Token budget above which a result is retained rather than inlined.

nextTool.description: A follow-up tool call (`{name, arguments}`) that continues or inspects this result.

responseBytes.description: Size of the full result in bytes.

workspaceId.description: Workspace holding a retained result, for inspection through virtual Bash.

title: Find Tools
